sell_grid_candle_wax_misread.expect: Barcelona sell grid, Iron 2,099 and Candle 148, Cargo 3,040/4,952. The badge specialist reads Candle as 2148 at conf 0.6519 (the melted wax left of the digits thresholds into a leading '2') while full-frame OCR reads 148 at 0.9987. The per-good bound does NOT catch it — 2,148 < 3,040 held. Only the sum does: 2,099 + 2,148 = 4,247. With supplies, 2,099 + 148 + 793 = 3,040 exactly.
